**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **No exclusivity binds us.** There is no sole-supplier, requirements, or "shall not procure from any third party" obligation on PB anywhere in the Agreement — this meets the playbook's *preferred* position.
- **The only exclusivity covenant favours us.** § 3.19 (p0369–p0374) binds SFJ and its Affiliates during the Exclusive Period (as defined at p0085) not to run trials on or sell Competing Products. Exclusivity granted *to* the customer is acceptable and expressly not a deviation.
- **§ 2.4 Approved CRO/Vendor architecture is not a de facto restriction.** It applies reciprocally to each Party and permits contracting with any Exhibit B/C listed party or any party JDC-approved — a joint quality gate, not a channelling of our spend to SFJ.
- **§ 3.14 supply provisions run our way.** SFJ must use only Product we supply (p0359), and we manufacture directly or through an Approved Vendor of our own selection (p0355).
- **§ 7.5 covenants noted, not flagged here.** The Licensing Transaction consent (p0552) and related negative covenants restrict out-licensing and financing, not our sourcing freedom; they belong to the financing/restrictive-covenant rules and are not double-counted under EXCLUSIVITY.
